The person you are thinking of is Dashrath Manjhi, widely known as the "Mountain Man". He did not try to flatten an entire mountain, but instead carved a 110-metre- long (360 ft) road through a steep rocky ridge in Gehlaur, India.
The Motivation
Wikipedia +1
• Tragedy: His wife, Falguni Devi, was badly hurt after falling on the rocky ridge.
No access: Because the mountain blocked the path, the nearest hospital was 55 to 70 kilometers away, and she passed away before receiving medical help.
